headline: On November 22, 1975: Juan Carlos declared King of Spain
captionCards: Chosen by Franco to succeed him in 1975
Led Spain’s peaceful transition to democracy
instagramCaption:
Juan Carlos I became King of Spain after Franco's death.

He was chosen by Franco but later dismantled the Francoist system.

Spain transitioned to democracy under his reign.

Surprisingly, he helped end a dictatorship he was meant to preserve.

His role shaped modern Spain’s democratic foundations.

How did a royal figure become a symbol of democracy?
